method: Independent model second-author review of all fourteen unchanged word/source-sense/frame/context/feature proposals, with exact current pinned English or Spanish lemma and word-form evidence checked. Literal plural animals/plants can be referred to as they; this is an exact present-indicative exception, not a global loosening of it-only or a claim of actual new runtime coverage. No native-human certification, word-suffix inference, command, modal/aspect, arbitrary subject or source scope expansion. Preserve all selected animal/plant and rare/regional context. Expose the selected they reading and scope any source ustedes-address tag as an unselected alternative, never active address; do not emit human or formal-you clauses.

approved.notes: Sheep or goats are plural bleating agents; no human complaint or invented sound-producing operator. Exact present indicative they-only reading; all other person, tense, mood, command and human/ustedes alternatives remain outside this approval.

limitations: Bindings apply only to the exact approved word, lemma/source records, selected sense, frame and present indicative third-person plural features.
Existing it-only restrictions remain for first/second person, formal-you, imperative, other moods/tenses and every unapproved spelling.
Do not infer plural license for impersonal weather from a conjugation table or an English regular plural verb.
